args.title: Document limits on report fields in API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The API reference currently does not include the limits on report fields, such as the maximum number of recipients, report name length, and category list size. Add these limits to the `Reports` section to help users avoid validation errors when using the API.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API reference doesn't include the limits on report fields such as the maximum number of recipients, the length of the report name, and the size of the category list. This should be documented to prevent validation errors when users interact with the API.
